kind: CLI tool: `chrombpnet pred_bw` (TensorFlow 2.8 / Keras h5 model; one prediction = one regions BED under one model)

chrombpnet.version_source: setup.py:17 ('version': '1.0.1'); no wheel is published for the tag — the checkout is the pin (tag == commit)
chrombpnet.archive_recipe: git archive --format=tar --prefix=chrombpnet-eaa0fe58/ eaa0fe58b6a43da62ea23b75cfc2bef4ecd3550c | gzip  (the whole tree at the tag: chrombpnet/, setup.py, requirements.txt, dockerfile, README.md, CHANGELOG.md, CITATION.cff, LICENSE, MANIFEST.in, images/)
chrombpnet.install: pip install -r requirements.txt && pip install -e chrombpnet   (dockerfile:49-54; an editable install of the checkout)

requirements_txt.source: requirements.txt at the tag (setup.py:5 reads it as install_requires); trailing whitespace stripped

stack.note: pins read from the two stacks below (importlib.metadata; CUDA per tf.sysconfig.get_build_info; the three CUDA libraries by ldconfig path + sha256, first 16 hex); the two stacks' Python package sets are identical (pip freeze byte-identical)

s1.role: the port's stack: the stock stack (s2) plus torch/triton at the pins_s1_only versions under the pins_s1_only root (not on the default sys.path; the kit inserts it)

s2.role: the stock stack: the dockerfile base + requirements.txt + the checkout; no torch

stack.certified_on: the s1 and s2 stacks below on H100 / H200 — a record; nothing compares against it

weights.root: $CHROMBPNET_OPT_WEIGHTS (configs/*.env, README.md Variables): the files below sit under it at these relative paths, one sha256 each

chrombpnet_recompiled.h5.role: the -cm model (the `pred_bw` model the tree pins): the two members below recombined, built by run.sh install --weights DIR (opt/chrombpnet_opt/weights.py recombine) when absent

bias_scaled.h5.role: component model beside -cm (the kit's K1 route reads it)

nobias.h5.role: component model beside -cm (the kit's K1 route reads it; the stock's -cmb input)

library_defaults.model_load: load_model_wrapper (predict_to_bigwig.py:115-122): get_custom_objects().update({'multinomial_nll': losses.multinomial_nll, 'tf': tf}) then tensorflow.keras.models.load_model(path, compile=False)
library_defaults.input_regions: 10-column narrowPeak BED read with NARROWPEAK_SCHEMA (predict_to_bigwig.py:16, :173); window = start+summit +/- inputlen/2 from the model's input_shape (:169, bigwig_helper.py:20); a region whose window is not fully inside the genome is dropped (bigwig_helper.py:21-25) and the kept rows written to _preds.bed (:180)
library_defaults.seed: none in the pred_bw path (no seed argument; the -s seed exists only on the train/prep parsers, parsers.py:67,:97)

reads: TF_* (TensorFlow's own variables, e.g. TF_DETERMINISTIC_OPS, TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL)
CUDA_CACHE_PATH / CUDA_CACHE_MAXSIZE (the driver's JIT cache, read by libcuda)
stock_environment.note: the prefixes are every os.environ name the kit's tf/ and torch/ code reads (grep of opt/kit_ho/tf and opt/kit/torch); the deterministic recipe names (TF_DETERMINISTIC_OPS, CHROMBPNET_DET_SUBPROCESS, CHROMBPNET_DET_SEED, PYTHONPATH -> opt/kit_ho/tf/det_subprocess/sitecustomize.py) are composed by the package's --det on every arm and are the only tolerated exceptions there
